modern_tabular.protocol: Existing official Adult test and exact 70/10/10/10 training splits; native missing/category handling. Identical Housing random/geographic holdouts and fit/selection/calibration partitions. Depth and early stopping validation-only; temperature fit on separate probability partition; conformal cutoff on separate calibration. CPU CatBoost, no external pretraining or test tuning. Frozen historical predictions provide paired Adult NLL comparisons.

modern_tabular_diagnostics.protocol: Post-fit official Adult test error analysis, never tuning. Groups with fewer than100 examples or a single observed class retain counts but omit unstable AUROC/TPR/FPR. Three feature permutations on the fixed first2500 test rows use calibrated NLL; importances are associative, not causal. Threshold, temperature and conformal cutoff remain training/validation/calibration selected.

modern_vision_diagnostics.protocol: Post-fit official CIFAR test confusion and calibrated top-label reliability. No test-based changes to models or calibration. External pretraining, architecture and fine-tuning differ from frozen-encoder baselines; this is not an equal-resource algorithm comparison.

modern_vision_calibration.protocol: Unchanged three fitted ConvNeXt checkpoints, original disjoint calibration partitions and all10,000 official test images. CUDA float64 scoring reproduces original probabilities within1e-6 and prediction-set coverage/size exactly. CPU uses its own reserved-partition temperature/conformal calibration. All six metadata-bound image commands verified on128 test images. Empty sets and singleton conditional accuracy retained; no claim of guaranteed conditional coverage. No test labels select a temperature, cutoff or model.
